AROM Summary 主動活動幅度摘要
Each joint has a normal ROM range of values, while each person has a different amount of ability to achieve it.
每個關節都有一個正常的活動幅度（ROM）值，而每個人達到此幅度的能力各不相同。
Below are generally accepted values for a normal ROM for some joints as measured in degrees:
以下是一些關節正常活動幅度的一般公認數值，以角度計算：
Normal AROM
正常主動活動幅度
Hip Flexion 髖關節屈曲
100
Hip Extension 髖關節伸展
30
Hip Abduction 髖關節外展
40
Hip Internal rotation 髖關節內旋
40
Hip External rotation髖關節外旋
50
Knee Flexion 膝關節屈曲
130
Knee Extension 膝關節伸展
0
Shoulder Flexion 肩屈曲
180
Shoulder Extension 肩部伸展
50
Shoulder Abduction 肩部外展
180
Shoulder Internal rotation 肩部內旋
90
Shoulder External rotation 肩部外旋
90
Elbow Flexion 肘部屈曲
140
Elbow Extension肘部伸展
0
